offset_note: 631 up to build 665 (run 34); 630 from run 36 on, because run 35 failed in CI before it published anything; 629 from run 38 on, because run 37 was cancelled before it published anything (run 38 = build 667). Run 39 stamped 668 with offset 629, but that installer was built with an empty release tag, so its manifest URL is the nonexistent tag v0.0.0-dev and the setup aborts with HTTP 404. 628 from run 40 on, so run 40 + 628 = 668 (codename Kolot). Runs 41-44 were test or failed runs and published nothing public. 655 from run 45 on, so run 45 + 655 = 700 (codename Kaporet). Run 45 published 700 Kaporet. Run 46 failed in the Windows unit tests before it published anything, so 654 from run 47 on: run 47 + 654 = 701 (codename Shalem).
codename_meaning: whole, complete (Biblical Hebrew shalem; Genesis 33:18, Jacob came shalem, whole, to Shechem) - every yo in the test dialogue, a command line for every part, and a second voice per role in multi-voice narration
